scope: Eight existing silver and steel worktools
Native Blender geometry and exact game export
owner_decisions: First work on pickaxes, axes, shovels and hoes; defer expedition gadgets
Steel area modes approved with explicit switching and per-block durability
WT02 direction closer to desired appearance; continue
Correct the hand orientation, especially left hand; make the shapes smoother and the pickaxe narrower
visual_contract: A complete connected head and continuous shaft; no floating tips
Minecraft pixel silhouette, no decorative render-only bevel or subdivision
Same native geometry and texture images in Blender and game
Moderate held scale; preserve readability in inventory
Only original or palette-only textures, with retained dimensions and alpha
gameplay_contract: Default single block; shift-use in air switches steel modes
Crouching while working temporarily suppresses area processing
Steel pickaxe and shovel operate on an explicit allowed material plane
Pickaxe extra blocks skip ores and all block entities
Axe fells connected same-species unstripped logs upward, maximum16 including original
Hoe uses normal per-block tool modification and player interaction hooks
Existing harvest tiers, durability capacities, stats, recipes and repair materials preserved
Standard enchantment and drop processing per affected block
Do not start area work if original removal failed
Respect cancellation, world border, loaded chunks and player permissions
No area processing in Creative or Adventure; no forced loading
Mode and unrelated item data survive save/load
validation_limits: GameTests are controlled fixtures, not a full Survival playthrough
GameTestServer excludes DH under the repository's known harness exception; native client includes DH
Third-party protection compatibility uses ordinary events but cannot guarantee every plugin implementation
Blender and game lighting are different
No live server or launcher deployment in this iteration
